brackets.name: Exhibition
brackets.description: Ultra-casual, theme-first decks. Winning is secondary to showing off something beloved or bizarre. No Game Changers, no mass land denial, no chained extra turns; two-card infinite combos are off the table.

brackets.name: Core
brackets.description: Precon-strength decks. Tuned enough to win, not tuned to dominate. No Game Changers, no mass land denial, no chained extra turns; two-card infinite combos are off the table.

brackets.name: Upgraded
brackets.description: Deliberately upgraded decks beyond precon power. Up to three Game Changers. Late-game two-card combos are acceptable; no mass land denial or chained extra turns.

brackets.name: Optimized
brackets.description: High-power decks with no list restrictions beyond the banned list. Fast mana, tutors, cheap combos, and any number of Game Changers are fair game.

brackets.name: cEDH
brackets.description: Competitive EDH. Metagame-focused, maximum-efficiency decks built to win tournaments. Same card pool as bracket 4, but a shared competitive mindset.
